content.text: {"label":"marketing_campaign","explanation":"General volume is running about 47% above forecast. The excess comes almost entirely from two call reasons. new_offer_enquiry is at 6.3x normal (+85 calls in the last hour), which matches the 11:30 FD special-rate email to 750k customers with a 'Call to book' call to action. account_update is at 2.1x normal, consistent with the 08:45 KYC re-verification SMS. Other general reasons are at or below normal. AHT is on or below forecast, so this is not system slowness. The only incident is a resolved overnight batch delay. Absence on general is lower than usual. Payments is close to forecast with 100% service level, despite 5 sick calls. General service level is 100% right now, but that is propped up by about 4 overtime agents above plan, and that overtime ends at 17:00.","plan_name":"Campaign tail cover: cross-skill from payments plus offer-enquiry chat deflection","rationale":"After 17:00 general loses its overtime cover while still running about 45% over forecast (around 90 calls per 15 min at about 350 s, roughly 35 Erlangs against about 40 planned agents). That leaves service level at risk. Payments is comfortably overstaffed: 100% service level, about 27 Erlangs against 40 agents. Moving 5 cross-skilled agents (about 12% of the donor, well under the 30% cap) is free and should keep payments well above 70%. Extending chat deflection at the 20% cap for new_offer_enquiry and balance_enquiry targets the main campaign driver cheaply: about 60–80 chats, roughly Rs 700–1,000. An IVR callback acts as a free safety net that only triggers if waits exceed 120 s. No new overtime is planned. About Rs 10,000 of the Rs 15,000 budget is already committed, so overtime is held in reserve in case general service level slips after 17:30.
